generate_podspec_from_bazel: run the script with a version flag to generate an abseil CocoaPods podspec from BUILD.bazel files
parse_bazel_xml_rule: parse a bazel XML rule element into a Rule namedtuple with normalized paths and dependencies
collect_cc_library_rules: recursively collect all cc_library rules from BUILD.bazel files under a given root directory
normalize_bazel_paths: normalize bazel label paths by stripping leading slashes and replacing colons with forward slashes
build_rule_directory_tree: build a nested dictionary tree of bazel rules organized by their podspec subspec hierarchy
